channel.title: KACH Hair Organic Solutions (en)
channel.description: KACH professional hair care: products, prices and availability

item.g:title: KACH BHX Botohair Effect Kit – Professional hair care kit
item.g:description: Hydration, reconstruction and repair in one kit. Intensive professional care for healthier, stronger and shinier hair. The kit is inspired by the hair botox effect and made with natural ingredients and advanced biotechnology. It repairs hair from within and restores moisture, strength, volume and extraordinary shine. Visible results from the very first use. The kit contains: 15 BHX ampoules (intensive moisturising treatment with a botox effect), Shampoo DC (deep cleansing that prepares hair for the treatment), Aminoplasma AP (intensive reconstruction) and Serum SSN (shine, silkiness, nourishment). Deep hydration, Reconstruction, Volume and shine, Professional results.

item.g:title: KACH Shampoo RH 250 ml – Rapid hydration shampoo
item.g:description: Gently cleanses and deeply moisturises dry and coloured hair. A blend of plant-based active ingredients cleanses gently and effectively without damaging the hair fibre. Ideal for dry hair and hair after chemical treatments. The moisturising and repairing formula reduces frizz: hair becomes softer, silkier and more lively. Fruit extracts, green tea, ginseng, blueberry and wheat germ, together with hyaluronic acid, collagen and keratin, give hair body, prevent split ends and keep moisture at an optimal level while preserving the hair's natural structure and colour. Deep hydration, Less frizz, Protection against split ends, Softness and shine.

item.g:title: KACH Shampoo RR 250 ml – Rapid repair shampoo
item.g:description: Repairing shampoo for dry and chemically treated hair. A repairing shampoo with top-quality ingredients, nourishing oils and precious extracts. Ideal for dry hair and hair after chemical treatments. Free from parabens and sulphates: it cleanses gently and non-aggressively and respects the hair fibre. It reduces frizz and makes hair stronger, fuller and silkier. Prevents split ends and strengthens hair while preserving its natural structure. item.g:title: KACH Only 1 One Shampoo 80 ml – Anti-frizz smoothing shampoo
item.g:description: Smooths and tames hair, eliminates frizz. A smoothing shampoo with a unique combination of organic acids and natural proteins. It acts on the bonds of the keratin chains inside the hair (in the cortex). The innovative heat-activated formula makes hair smooth, shiny and frizz-free. Tamarind, apple, sugar cane and milk extracts, together with hyaluronic acid and very low molecular weight ceramides, repair hair and make it silky. Smooths, Eliminates frizz, Extra shine, Moisturises, Strengthens.

Argan oil, jojoba oil, narcissus flower extract and ceramides seal and repair hair without weighing it down. Hair becomes silky, very shiny and manageable, and the style holds perfectly. Radiance, Silkiness, Deep nourishment, Free from parabens and sulphates.

item.g:title: KACH Crema CSN 100 ml – Volume cream: shine and nourishment

Ideal for normal and fine hair: it gives volume and a defined shape without making hair greasy or heavy. Free from parabens and sulphates. Hair becomes silky, shiny and easy to style. item.g:title: KACH BHX Botohair Effect 20 ml – Intensive hair hydration, ampoules
item.g:description: Deep hydration concentrate with an effect lasting up to three weeks. A highly concentrated formula with hyaluronic acid, ceramides and a blend of precious argan, jojoba and avocado oils. A deep hydration treatment with a visible effect lasting up to three weeks. It helps control frizz, seals the cuticle and split ends, and gives softness and radiance. Suitable as an after-colour treatment or as a sealing product after treatments such as botoplex. It can be added to colours, bleaches and straightening products to protect and nourish hair. Deep hydration, Frizz control, Seals the ends, Softness and radiance.
